title: 鋼軌超音波探傷
summary: 鋼軌超音波探傷以「聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。超音波探傷以聲束與缺陷交互作用取得間接證據，耦合、角度和鋼軌幾何會改變回波；沒有回波不能獨立證明沒有裂紋。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops sound paths refraction coupling blind zones and defect evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Ultrasonic testing obtains indirect evidence from beam-defect interaction; coupling, angle and rail geometry alter echoes, so absence of an echo alone does not prove absence of a crack. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=77.7817 mm。模型邊界：角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm. Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=77.7817 mm. Boundary: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 垂直回波深度與斜入射聲程
stages.titleEn: Normal echo depth & Oblique sound path
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直回波深度」與「斜入射聲程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Normal echo depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 64.9 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一。使用已知厚度試塊的回波時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直回波深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 64.9 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector. Use echo time from a block of known thickness as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Normal echo depth” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直回波深度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Normal echo depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use echo time from a block of known thickness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直回波深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Normal echo depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「垂直回波深度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use echo time from a block of known thickness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using known-thickness teaching block, time-zero calibration and full echo waveform, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Normal echo depth. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 只保留成功案例會使績效失真。這個失效與「盲測漏檢比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測反射體清單與報告，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Keeping only successful cases distorts performance. This failure and a measurement bias in Blind-test miss fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded reflector inventory and test report rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用盲測反射體清單與報告作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只保留成功案例會使績效失真，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keeping only successful cases distorts performance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只保留成功案例會使績效失真」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Keeping only successful cases distorts performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
